notes: A good solution fans out with Task.WhenAll (or equivalent), isolates per-carrier retry logic in one method, applies the timeout with WaitAsync or a linked CancellationTokenSource, and keeps caller cancellation distinguishable from carrier timeouts. Sequential awaits, blocking calls (.Result, .Wait()), swallowing OperationCanceledException from the caller, or catch-all handlers that hide cancellation would be correctness or readability regressions.
